'''Grebe-Korora''' was a [[Gender|male]] [[Lanai]] [[porter]] who resided on the [[planet]] [[Ahch-To]]. Hailing from [[Temple Island]], he was a member of the group known as the [[Visitors]], along with all the other [[Gender|male]] members of his [[species]] from the island. The group spent almost all of their time traveling to other islands across the planet's [[ocean]]s on a [[fleet]] of handcrafted [[Boat|vessels]], fishing and [[hunting]] in order to feed the [[Caretakers|female Lanais]] back at their home. When Grebe-Korora and the other Visitors did return once each [[Standard month|month]] they and the females would celebrate a [[Festival of Return]], in which they danced and amended old relationships for several [[Standard day|days]] before the males returned to their travels. Korora wore a [[Color|brown]] [[Clothing|robe]] with a light brown [[belt]] and fingerless [[glove]]s and a blue [[scarf]] beneath a flat [[hat]] tied on with string. Grebe-Korora had gray and white skin.<ref name="TLJVD" />

==Behind the scenes==
Grebe-Korora was created to be a part of the film [[Star Wars: Episode VIII The Last Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VIII ''The Last Jedi'']];<ref name="TLJVD" /> however, the scene he appeared in was ultimately cut before the final release.<ref name="TLJ">{{Film|VIII}}</ref> Despite this, the character still appeared in ''[[Star Wars: The Last Jedi: The Visual Dictionary]]'', a reference book written by [[Pablo Hidalgo]]<ref name="TLJVD" /> and released alongside the film on [[December 15]], [[2017]].<ref name="Release date">{{SW|url=news/new-star-wars-the-last-jedi-books-and-more-revealed-at-sdcc-2017|text=New ''Star Wars: The Last Jedi'' Books and More Revealed at SDCC 2017}}</ref> He is a playable character in the [[2022]] [[Traveller's Tales]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[LEGO Star Wars: The Skywalker Saga]]''.<ref name="LEGO">''[[LEGO Star Wars: The Skywalker Saga]]''</ref>
